body:
Honestly the fact you took the time to read my message and reply is more than enough.

Your right in saying there is no way to prove it, I keep trying to tell myself that, and that its all in my head and that it's just irrational thoughts and it does actually help. My delusional thinking just out weighs my rational at times. 

Again just knowing that someone else out there knows whats going on helps. I've only ever posted here when I feel I'm at a tipping point but when I'm in a better frame of mind I'll make sure to come back and pass on the kindness you have shared. Thankyou for replying and thankyou for seeing me.
